content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_80020 In case of "event" semantic an IOC_E_LOST_DATA Overlayed Error shall be returned by the IocReceiveGroup function if the IOC communication service refused an Ioc- SendGroup request from sender due to an internal buffer overflow. There is no error in the data returned in parameter.

In case of "event" semantic an IOC_E_LOST_DATA Overlayed Er- ror shall be returned by the IocReceiveGroup function if the IOC communication service refused an IocSendGroup request from sender due to an internal buffer over- flow. There is no error in the data returned in parameter.
